title: McMullen's Curve, the Weil Locus, and the Hodge Conjecture for Abelian Sixfolds
summary: McMullen's compact Kobayashi-geodesic curve $V \subset X_L$, arising from the hyperbolic triangle group $Δ(14,21,42)$ via a modular embedding into the Hilbert modular sixfold $X_L = \mathbb{H}^6/\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathcal{O}_L)$ attached to the totally real cyclic field $L = \mathbb{Q}(\cos\tfracπ{21})$, is not contained in any proper Shimura subvariety of $X_L$, and the generic fiber $A_v$ satisfies $\mathrm{MT}(A_v) = \mathrm{Res}_{L/\mathbb{Q}}\,\mathrm{SL}_2$, hence carries no exceptional Hodge tensors.
